# CareerAgent

> Automate the job hunt. Keep your privacy intact.

CareerAgent is a **100% free, open-source, local-first reverse ATS** built for software engineers. It runs entirely on your machine via Docker — no accounts, no subscriptions, no cloud.

It continuously scrapes job boards, evaluates every listing against your resume using a rubric-guided LLM, generates tailored LaTeX CVs, and tracks your pipeline autonomously in the background. Your data never leaves your machine.

## What it does

- **Automated job discovery** — Playwright headless scrapers for standard ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby). A companion Chrome Extension bypasses IP bans on LinkedIn and Naukri.
- **5-dimension AI scoring** — LLM rubric grades jobs across technical match, experience level, compensation, cultural signals, and red flags. Outputs a strict 0–100 score per job.
- **Native LaTeX CV generation** — 1-click keyword injection into your base resume + local PDF compilation. No cloud PDF service.
- **Open-ended answer drafts** — Reads Greenhouse/Ashby/Lever forms, drafts "Why this role?" answers from your CV. Never auto-submits.
- **Global crowdsourced job network** — Opt-in to an anonymous job pool to share and receive scraped jobs from the community. Your personal data is never shared.
- **Kanban pipeline** — Visual board to track New, Applied, Interviewing, and Rejected applications.
- **Bring your own AI** — Gemini (free tier), OpenAI, Anthropic, or fully local via Ollama.

## Privacy model

Everything lives in a local SQLite database. No telemetry. No accounts. No OAuth. No third-party data mining. The only network request made on your behalf is the Gemini API call for job scoring — and even that can be replaced with a local Ollama model.

## Who built this

Open-source project by [@koteshrv](https://github.com/koteshrv). MIT License.

## Privacy model

CareerAgent is designed around a strict local-first privacy model. All personal data — your resume, AI match scores, application notes, and pipeline history — lives in a local SQLite database on your own machine. No user accounts are required. No OAuth. No SSO.

Your instance makes exactly two types of external network calls:

1. **Gemini API (or Ollama)** — The AI call to score and tailor jobs against your resume. This can be pointed at a locally running Ollama model for fully air-gapped, offline operation.
2. **Global Crowdsourced Job Network** — Enabled by default; can be turned off in **Settings → Data**. Your instance automatically shares scraped public job listings with a community pool and pulls back jobs scraped by other CareerAgent users — growing your coverage as a network effect. **Only public job listing data is exchanged (title, company, URL, description). Your resume, scores, notes, settings, and any personally identifiable information are never transmitted.**

## Links

- Website: https://careeragent.fyi

## Getting started

```bash
curl -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/koteshrv/career-agent/main/docker-compose.yml
docker compose up -d
# Visit http://localhost:5173
# Add your free Gemini API key in Settings → Resume & AI
```

No sign-up. No accounts. No SSO. Just Docker and a free Gemini API key.

## Frequently asked questions

**Does it auto-apply?**
No. It prepares everything up to the submit button (resume, cover letter, form answers) then hands the decision back to you.

**Is it really free?**
Yes. Permanently. MIT-licensed. No paid tier, no waitlist.

**Does it need an account?**
No. Single-user, entirely local. No Google/GitHub sign-in, no OAuth.

**Where does my data go?**
Nowhere. Local SQLite file on your disk.
